content: <thought>To design a ≤3‑step synthesis, I will disconnect the target at the sulfonamide N–S bond and at the amide C–N bond. This gives two commercially available precursors: (1) p‑toluenesulfonyl chloride (TsCl) and (2) the aniline that already contains the trans‑cinnamoyl‑amide side chain. The latter can be made in one step by coupling 4‑aminocinnamic acid (commercial) with p‑phenylenediamine (commercial). Thus the overall route is two steps: (i) amide coupling of 4‑aminocinnamic acid with p‑phenylenediamine → intermediate aniline; (ii) sulfonylation of that aniline with TsCl → target. Both precursors are buyable and inexpensive, keeping the total cost well below $9999. I will now retrieve suitable reaction‑template IDs for an amide‑formation (acid + amine) and a sulfonyl‑chloride‑amine coupling, then construct the JSON retrosynthesis tree.
